name: api_site_visit_acts_approve
_description: PLAN V1.0 Bloque 10 - POST /api/v1/site-visit-acts/approve. action='approve' -> status='approved' approved_by/at. action='sign' -> requiere status='approved' -> status='signed' signed_at (definitivo, no editable).

parameters.query:
WITH ctx AS (
  SELECT set_session_context($1::uuid, $2::uuid, $3) AS ok
),
act AS (
  SELECT s.id, s.project_id, s.tenant_id, s.status, s.visit_date,
         s.approved_by, s.approved_at, s.signed_at,
         p.name AS project_name
  FROM site_visit_acts s JOIN projects p ON p.id = s.project_id, ctx
  WHERE s.id = $4::uuid LIMIT 1
),
upd AS (
  UPDATE site_visit_acts SET
    status = CASE
      WHEN $5 = 'approve' AND status = 'draft' THEN 'approved'
      WHEN $5 = 'sign' AND status = 'approved' THEN 'signed'
      ELSE status
    END,
    approved_by = CASE WHEN $5 = 'approve' AND status = 'draft' THEN $1::uuid ELSE approved_by END,
    approved_at = CASE WHEN $5 = 'approve' AND status = 'draft' THEN now() ELSE approved_at END,
    signed_at = CASE WHEN $5 = 'sign' AND status = 'approved' THEN now() ELSE signed_at END
  WHERE id = $4::uuid
  RETURNING id, status, approved_at, signed_at
)
SELECT act.id, act.status AS prev_status, act.project_id, act.project_name, act.visit_date,
       upd.status AS new_status, upd.approved_at, upd.signed_at
FROM act LEFT JOIN upd ON true;
